summary: Hardened $inputId JS interpolation in BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageJumpInput() using json_encode($inputId) instead of bare string interpolation.
Removed constructor property promotion from GridPagination — replaced with explicit property declaration and assignment to match codebase convention.

comments.note: Both renderers (BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer) contain nearly identical createPageJumpInput() implementations — the bootstrap variant only differs in CSS classes. A future refactor could extract shared logic into a common base method to avoid duplication.

summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified by code inspection and test execution.

AC1: Both BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageJumpInput() correctly use json_encode($inputId) to produce $encodedInputId, which is interpolated into the JS string — XSS hardening confirmed.
AC2: GridPagination has explicit private DataGridInterface $grid property declaration at class level and constructor assigns via $this->grid = $grid — no constructor promotion.
AC3: All 47 PHPUnit tests pass (47/47, 63 assertions). No regressions.
PHPStan: 14 pre-existing errors in unrelated files; zero new errors introduced by the changes.

comments.note: json_encode() on $inputId is the correct XSS fix; however if a caller ever supplies a non-UTF-8 grid ID, json_encode() returns false (PHP returns string|false). In practice auto-generated IDs are pure ASCII so this is negligible, but adding JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR flag would make failure explicit.

No observations about regressions — all 47 tests remain green. Pre-existing PHPStan errors (14 total in BaseGridColumn, DataGrid, GridForm, RowManager, HeaderRow, MergedRow) are unrelated to this WP and unchanged.

summary: Code review PASS. All three acceptance criteria verified by direct source inspection, PHPStan (zero errors on modified files), and PHPUnit (47/47 tests, 63 assertions).

XSS fix is correct: json_encode() wraps both $inputId and $urlTemplate in JSON double-quoted strings, which HTMLTag::attr() then HTML-encodes for safe placement in onclick attributes. Browser parses " back to " in JS context — the round-trip is safe.
GridPagination constructor refactor is idiomatic and matches codebase convention; no regressions.

comments.note: json_encode() on both $inputId and $urlTemplate returns string|false. If either value contained malformed UTF-8, json_encode returns false, which PHP silently interpolates as the empty string — producing a broken (non-functional) but non-exploitable page-jump button. Adding JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR as the flags argument would make failure explicit and catch it early. PHPStan level 6 raises no error on the current code since implicit string coercion of false is technically legal, but stricter analysis (level 8+) would flag it.

BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageJumpInput() share identical logic (same JSON encoding, same JS string, same HTMLTag structure) — they diverge only on CSS classes. A template-method in the base class with an overridable wrapPageJumpContainer() hook would eliminate the risk of future security fixes needing to be applied twice.
No blocking issues found. The security fix is correctly applied, the convention change is clean, and no regressions were introduced.

summary: Reviewed implementation artifacts for WP-001 (XSS hardening of page-jump JS output + GridPagination constructor convention fix).
No public API changes — no signature updates needed in api-surface.md.
Added XSS-safety note to BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() in api-surface.md, and updated Bootstrap5Renderer private helpers comment to flag the same json_encode() safety guarantee.

Added Coding Convention #11 to constraints.md: no constructor property promotion — explicit property declaration + constructor-body assignment required. This encodes the rule that the GridPagination fix enforced and prevents future violations.
README.md, data-flows.md, and tech-stack.md are unaffected — output structure, rendering pipeline, and dependencies are all unchanged.

comments.note: The json_encode() XSS fix is fully safe for all auto-generated ASCII grid IDs. The edge-case where json_encode() returns false on malformed UTF-8 input (flagged by QA and Reviewer) is a theoretical risk only — no documentation change required, but the api-surface.md note now directs future readers to the security intent of the encoding.
